floors.label: feature/agenda, excluding Compose-only subtrees
floors.note: The excluded subtrees are Compose-only and are covered by the desktopApp flow tests, which kover cannot see. Including them yields 33.18% and would say more about the harness than about the tests.

floors.label: whole shared module
floors.note: The floor that makes the agenda ratchet mean something. Without it, deleting every test in feature/tasks would leave the gate green, since a single-feature floor cannot see erosion elsewhere.

floors.label: feature/tasks (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Largest feature by line count. Without its own floor, deleting every task test would still leave the whole-module floor green.

floors.label: feature/notes (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Second largest. Same reasoning as tasks.

floors.label: feature/projects (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Cascade deletes and parent/child relationships live here; a regression there is expensive to find by hand.

floors.label: feature/ai (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Every AI call is metered into llm_usage, so an unnoticed coverage drop here also hides an untested billing path.

floors.label: feature/search (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Best-covered feature; the floor exists to keep it that way as code is added.

floors.label: feature/proposals (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Previously a Livewire screen port; coverage there is the regression guard for the port.

floors.label: feature/calendar_sync (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Long-lived debounced collector, hard to test by hand.
